title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 192 (Representation of principal by sub-agent properly appointed)

content.overview: Where a sub-agent is properly appointed, the principal is, so far as regards third persons, represented by the sub-agent, and is bound by and responsible for his acts, as if he were an agent originally appointed by the principal. The agent is responsible to the principal for the acts of the sub-agent. The sub-agent is responsible for his acts to the agent, but not to the principal, except in cases of fraud or wilful wrong.
content.glance: Properly appointed sub-agent represents principal to third persons; agent responsible to principal for sub-agent; sub-agent responsible to agent (not principal) except for fraud or wilful wrong.
content.study: Where a sub-agent is properly appointed, the principal is, so far as regards third persons, represented by the sub-agent, and is bound by and responsible for his acts, as if he were an agent originally appointed by the principal. The agent is responsible to the principal for the acts of the sub-agent. The sub-agent is responsible for his acts to the agent, but not to the principal, except in cases of fraud or wilful wrong. Contrast s. 193 (appointment without authority).

sections.heading: Principal represented to third persons
sections.body: Principal bound by and responsible for properly appointed sub-agent’s acts as if originally appointed by the principal.

sections.heading: Agent responsible to principal
sections.body: Agent is responsible to the principal for the acts of the sub-agent.

sections.heading: Sub-agent’s responsibility
sections.body: Sub-agent responsible to the agent, not to the principal, except in fraud or wilful wrong.

provisions.title: Representation of principal by sub-agent properly appointed

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 192 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Confirm proper appointment; apply principal’s representation to third persons; agent’s responsibility to principal; sub-agent’s limited responsibility to agent except fraud/wilful wrong.
